content: TradingAgents (TauricResearch): ~102.6k stars, 19.8k forks. Five teams - analysts (fundamentals/sentiment/news/technical), bull-vs-bear researcher debate, trader, risk management, portfolio manager. v0.3.x/v0.4.0 added LangGraph checkpoint resume, decision-log memory with realized returns, structured-output agents, and look-ahead/point-in-time data access fixes. Executes against a SIMULATED exchange only. Explicit disclaimer: research purposes, performance varies with backbone model/temperature/period/data, not financial advice. Treat as a research artifact producer, never an execution authority.
